caption: The drawing depicts a brown carousel horse, oriented to the right and shown in a prancing position with its right front leg raised and mouth open. The mane and tail of the horse are dark gray, almost black, and the horse features a beige saddle. The saddle blanket beneath it is patterned in a diamond motif with alternating red and green diamonds bordered by green and accented with yellow lines. The horse wears a decorative harness and bridle in red and green, with a circular blue accent near the ear. Metallic gray stirrups hang down from strapping beneath the saddle. The hooves are black. The background is plain light beige, with the drawing enclosed inside a thin rectangular border. In the bottom left corner, there is a smaller line drawing of the same horse with basic measurements labeled, showing the height and length of the figure. The artist’s name, Ernest A. Towers Jr., and a reference number, DEL.2591, are printed in the lower right.
title: Carousel Horse
